subject.title: feat(talk): describe_view inline vision for OpenAI Realtime + Gemini Live

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a narrowed Gemini Live browser-direct Video Talk implementation after the branch adopts the current scoped camera-permission boundary and supplies real provider proof?
rationale: The remaining work intentionally exposes camera frames to a realtime provider and therefore needs explicit maintainer acceptance of the provider, consent, and no-Gateway-transit boundary; tests alone cannot establish that policy choice.

options.title: Sponsor narrowed Gemini slice
options.body: Rebase to a Gemini-only patch, preserve scoped camera permission, fix denial handling, and require real Gemini Live proof before merge.

options.title: Defer Gemini Live
options.body: Keep the merged OpenAI implementation as the supported scope and close or park this branch until Gemini Live has a separately sponsored design.

options.title: Require generic transport first
options.body: Move Gemini support behind the provider/gateway transport design tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89131 before adding another direct browser path.

recommendation.title: Sponsor narrowed Gemini slice
recommendation.body: Rebase to a Gemini-only patch, preserve scoped camera permission, fix denial handling, and require real Gemini Live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person merged the OpenAI extraction and explicitly stated that Gemini Live remains the decision surface in this PR.
